This is written in the Indian (lakh/crore) grouping: `4 | 18 | 25 | 000`, i.e. groups of 3, 3, then 2 going leftward. Its digit string is 41825000, so its plain value is 4,18,25,000 = 41,825,000.

**Restatement 1 — in crore** (1 crore = 10⁷ = 1,00,00,000)

418,25,000 ÷ 1,00,00,000 = 4.1825

> **₹4.1825 crore** (four crore, eighteen lakh, twenty-five thousand rupees)

Check: 4.1825 × 10⁷ = 41,825,000 ✔ same value as the document.

**Restatement 2 — international grouping** (groups of 3 from the right: millions, thousands, units)

> **₹41,825,000** (forty-one million, eight hundred twenty-five thousand rupees)

Check: 41 × 10⁶ + 825 × 10³ = 41,000,000 + 825,000 = 41,825,000 ✔ same value as the document.

Place-value cross-check of the original string, digit by digit:

| digit | 4 | 1 | 8 | 2 | 5 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| place | 10⁷ | 10⁶ | 10⁵ | 10⁴ | 10³ | 10² | 10¹ | 10⁰ |
| value | 40,000,000 | 1,000,000 | 800,000 | 20,000 | 5,000 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

Sum = 41,825,000, which matches both restatements. So the original grouping (4,18,25,000), the crore form (4.1825 crore) and the international form (41,825,000) are three notations of one and the same figure — no rounding was applied anywhere.
